mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) over the past three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where RSAFS increases over the past three months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the past month, it signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200k and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5% in 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.25% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% over the past month, it signals a tightening monetary policy in response to inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 0.25% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months signals strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 increases over the past six months.
